title: Gold Rate Today, Aug 17: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹14,320 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹50) and ₹1,14,560 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹400).
